description: Fetch a page's markdown twin by its path: /record/{slug}.md (add ?as_of=YYYY-MM-DD for a past day), /record/{slug}/{predicate}.md (a fact page: one fact's every dated value, e.g. /record/anthropic/revenue.md; entity_state's fact_pages lists them), /record/{slug}/diff.md?from=YYYY-MM-DD&to=YYYY-MM-DD (what changed between two days, as entity_diff answers), /timelines/{slug}.md, /timelines/{slug}/{YYYY}.md (one year of a timeline), /claim/{id}.md, /day/{YYYY-MM-DD}.md, /days/{YYYY}.md, /brief/{YYYY-MM-DD}.md, /brief/week/{YYYY-MM-DD}.md, /trends/{topic}.md (add ?in=ai or ?in=tech, and ?company=<key> for one company), or a site page: /index.md, /record.md, /timelines.md, /changes.md, /days.md, /brief.md, /trends.md, /facts.md, /people.md, /models.md, /identifiers.md, /about.md, /api-docs.md, /connect.md, /compare.md, /as-of-date.md, /data.md, /privacy.md, /terms.md. A query string a page does not read is refused. A day after today or an impossible date is not a page. A page longer than 48,000 characters is cut at a line, with a note naming the tool that returns the rest.

id.description: Page path ending in .md, with its query string if any, e.g. /record/google.md, /record/anthropic/revenue.md, /trends/models.md?company=openai or /about.md

name: fetch

complete.description: false when the page was cut

title: Fetch a page as markdown
